threat_event: Covered video surveillance equipment is found at the central monitoring station or in installed systems
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Installation business not screened; 4 NVRs unconfirmed
treatment_plan: Confirm the 4 NVRs by 2026-11-30; screen installation purchases (POAM-022, POAM-023)
owner: Janitorial and Security technology services director

threat_event: ROC-2 is lost and the central monitoring station cannot fail over to ROC-1
Consumer reports in the applicant tracking system are viewed beyond need or breached
regulatory_driver: N56-R02 (15 U.S.C. 1681b(b)); Fla. Stat. 501.171 (Florida worked example)

threat_event: The AI applicant screening tool produces disparate impact
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No bias audit; vendor documentation missing
regulatory_driver: Colorado SB26-189 (Colorado applicants from 2027-01-01); Title VII
treatment_plan: Impact ratio testing and vendor documentation before 2027-01-01 (P10)

threat_event: Video analytics miss a real intrusion or flood operators with false alerts
existing_controls: Operator verification of every alert; scheduled guard tours
treatment_plan: Detection testing per site; alert quality metrics (P10)

threat_event: Consumer reports and I-9 copies are kept too long or disposed of improperly
regulatory_driver: N56-R01 (16 CFR 682.3); N56-R03 (8 CFR 274a.2(b)(2)); Fla. Stat. 448.095(2) (Florida worked example)

threat_event: A scheduling outage leaves posts unstaffed
Staff follow the 2022 policy set where it conflicts with group policy
owner: Janitorial and Security security and compliance lead

threat_event: Former workers keep customer-site badges and keys
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: About 4 days to disable or recover credentials; 58% turnover
regulatory_driver: Customer contract terms; IRS Pub. 1075 2.B.2 and CJISSECPOL v6.1 (by customer contract)
treatment_plan: Same-day disable through the IBOP for shared sites; key audits (POAM-007)

threat_event: A monitoring operator is phished and the attacker silences alarms through the monitoring module
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Operators use email on console workstations
treatment_plan: Separate console workstations from email; alarm suppression alerts

threat_event: A 72-hour monitoring customer notice is missed
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Commercial contracts not in the inventory
treatment_plan: Add monitoring contracts to the inventory (POAM-005)

threat_event: Ransomware enters through installation business systems
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Legacy file server from the acquisition
treatment_plan: Migrate SYS-J3 into the landing zone
owner: Janitorial and Security technology services director

threat_event: Customer panel credentials kept in spreadsheets leak
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Credentials for about 900 customers' systems in spreadsheets
treatment_plan: Move credentials to the group vault (POAM-002)
owner: Janitorial and Security technology services director

vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Requests from a county and a commercial customer
regulatory_driver: Fla. Stat. 501.171 and 501.702 (Florida worked example); FTC Act Section 5
treatment_plan: Declined by the Group AI council (P10)

threat_event: A guard tour phone is lost with cached post orders
